newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shum Yip to price shares at HK$1.85 each - sources.
newsitem.headline: Shum Yip to price shares at HK$1.85 each - sources.

text.p: Shenzhen municipal government-backed Shum Yip Holdings Co Ltd is expected to price its shares in its initial public offer at HK$1.85 each, market sources said on Tuesday.
Sources said the price was at the high end of the initial price range of HK$1.60 to HK$1.85 per share.
The international placement portion of the issue is also seen to be over 20 times subscribed, sources said.

Shum Yip is expected to issue 250 million new shares, of which 70 percent will be placed to international investors and the remaining 30 percent opened for public subscription in Hong Kong from February 21 to 26, sources said.
Dealing in shares on the stock exchange of Hong Kong is expected on March 6, they said.

Net proceeds from the new issue will be used to develop coach services between Shenzhen and other China cities, to fund nationwide car renting services, for property development projects and as general working capital, they said.
